company_evidence.actor_scope: KarazhanbasMunai company/management stance as reproduced in the archived company-release text; do not attribute worker-side or government claims to the company.
coder_visible_evidence: The company describes an internal dispute within the Karazhanbas workers' union and identifies competing positions around union leadership.

The company states that management is not entitled to interfere in the union's internal affairs, while also stating that the demand to remove the incumbent union chairman was unlawful because required meeting procedures were not followed.
The company states that some collective-agreement demands had been considered by a commission and that certain agreements had been reached, pending worker approval.
The company officially states that conducting negotiations through the protest action in that manner was unacceptable and that rights should be defended through lawful procedures.
The company reports that constructive dialogue with participants ended the protest action on 12 May.
